narr: Storms repeatedly moved across portions of northeast Iowa during the evening of July 5th. Radar estimates suggest between 3 and 4 inches of rain fell from these storms which resulted in some localized flash flooding. Rocks and other debris were pushed onto some roads near McGregor (Clayton County).
ev: Runoff from heavy rain caused some flash flooding to occur near McGregor. Rocks and debris were pushed onto some roads.
lsr: ROCKS AND DEBRIS IN THE ROAD ON VARIOUS ROADWAYS NEAR MCGREGOR DUE TO WATER FLOW OUT OF THE HILLS.
